verdict.rationale: Data region or residency selection is a fair question for a cloud-synced note-taking SaaS like Capacities. However, nothing in the evidence pack covers storage regions, residency choices, or self-hosting. The pack documents only adjacent privacy and sync features (opt-in AI data sharing, offline-first sync, exports), which earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
